items.title: Episode Review — Cariboo Signals, October 5, 2026
items.content_html:
What the pipeline did, what broke, and what it chose when something broke. Run 37287761323.

Primary run failed; fallback succeeded with Cohere embed failures

The 1:05 AM primary run did not complete. The 2:05 AM fallback (run 37287761323) finished in 23 minutes with a success conclusion. That run is the source of all shipped content below.

Three Cohere embedding operations failed with ModuleNotFoundError during script generation. The pipeline fell back to non-Cohere paths for evolving-story detection and same-story clustering. For deep-dive reranking, it kept the keyword ranking instead. These degradations mean the script used simpler clustering and ranking than designed, but produced output.

Script expanded after first draft came short

The first draft measured 2785 words against a 3400-word target. The script was sent back for expansion and shipped at 3184 words. The target was not met, but the gap closed from 615 words to 216 words.

One TTS segment returned shorter than its word count predicted. It was retried once per protocol and included in the final audio.

Citation coverage complete; story ordering still imperfect

All 15 roundup citations matched their sources. All 3 deep-dive citations matched. The pipeline found no reference gaps in either segment.

Five stories still aired out of intended order after one repair pass in the roundup-order step. This is a recurring degradation: the reordering logic has not fully stabilized.

Deep dives and debate

Three deep dives shipped: MoMA on information design (Fast Company), a Man in Motion film screening (Williams Lake Tribune), and a Putin disinformation operation narrative (Mother Jones).

The debate question: Should arts and cultural organizations rely primarily on quantitative metrics like attendance counts to measure value and success, or should they prioritize qualitative community input and contextual understanding?

Audio, video, and distribution

The episode ran 18.4 minutes of audio and video. Audio file: 16.9 MB. Video file: 63.3 MB. This episode marked RSS entry 250.

One object referenced by podcast-feed.xml is missing from Cloudflare R2 and cannot be healed from disk. Crawlers will 404 on that asset.

Quality and voice balance

Casey spoke 1.01 times as much as Riley — near parity. The script triggered one AI-tell pattern hit during quality review.

Compute and API calls

The run consumed 50,860 Anthropic input tokens across 13 Claude calls. Search and answers came from 7 Brave Search calls and 5 Brave Answers calls.

Roundup pool held 49 more stories than the airtime budget allowed. Those 49 stories were cut and remain available for later matching.
